instruction: Studio portrait photograph, full shot, front view. In an indoor studio with a draped beige fabric backdrop, three generations of women pose together. In the background, the older woman with short dark hair (R1) sits behind R2, smiling warmly. In the middle ground, the younger woman with medium-length brown hair (R2) sits with legs spread wide, looking down at the child with a smile. In the foreground, the little girl with light brown hair (R3) sits between R2's legs, smiling at the camera. R2 wraps her arms around R3's waist as R3 leans back. Soft, diffused studio lighting creates a warm, neutral-toned atmosphere.
